title: FIAT MODE
captionIntro: Fiat Mode lets this wallet hold a stable unit instead of bitcoin, so everyday amounts feel familiar while you still use Bitcoin under the hood on Arkade.
captionMutiny: On Mutinynet, Fiat Mode uses USDT and shows USD. No KYC is applied.
captionMainnet: On mainnet, Brazilian Real (BRL via DePix) is available. More stables can join later. No KYC is applied.
captionLeave: You can leave Fiat Mode anytime and switch back to sats.
captionSelect: Select a stable below, then confirm on this page. Back cancels without changing mode. Conversion cost is about %{feePct}%, minimum %{minSats} sats.
footnoteNeedsArkade: Fiat Mode needs an Arkade wallet selected on Home.
footnoteMutiny: USDT is the active Fiat Mode path on Mutinynet.
footnoteMainnet: Cards will let you choose which stable to use. For now only BRL is active on mainnet.
maxiCaption1: When Bitcoin Maxi Mode is on, other assets that arrive on this wallet's Ark address are converted to bitcoin (sats) automatically. Your home balance stays in sats instead of collecting alt balances.
maxiCaption2: This runs quietly in the background, like Fiat Mode's inbound conversion, but in the opposite direction. A small solver fee applies (about %{feePct}% on this network), the same family of fee as Fiat Mode swaps.
maxiCaption3: Fiat Mode still wins when it is active: inbound value follows Fiat Mode rules instead. Turning Maxi Mode off is not available yet.
